run_rerank: run rerank on a query against a list of documents using AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime
run_arerank: run async rerank on a prepared request against AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime rerank endpoint
build_prepare_request: build a SigV4-authenticated AWS request for Bedrock rerank with custom headers and endpoint
transform_rerank_request: transform a RerankRequest into the Bedrock Agent Runtime JSON payload format
transform_rerank_response: transform a Bedrock Agent Runtime rerank JSON response into a RerankResponse object
